id.description: The unique identifier for the site.

contentUrl.description: The URL namespace for the site.

adminMode.description: The administrator mode for the site.

state.description: The current state of the site.

storageQuota.description: The storage quota for the site in megabytes.

userQuota.description: The maximum number of users for the site. A value of -1 indicates no limit.

numCreators.description: The number of Creator-licensed users on the site.

numExplorers.description: The number of Explorer-licensed users on the site.

numViewers.description: The number of Viewer-licensed users on the site.

disableSubscriptions.description: Whether subscriptions are disabled on the site.

revision.description: The revision number of the site.
